pairs.difference: Shimla is the capital, with Mall Road and the toy train; Manali is for Rohtang, Solang and adventure sports.
Goa is Portuguese-influenced, with parties and shacks; Pondicherry is French-influenced and quiet, with yellow streets.
Dubai has the Burj Khalifa and shopping; Abu Dhabi is the capital, with Ferrari World.
Ooty has the toy train and the botanical garden; Kodaikanal is built around its star-shaped lake.
Jaipur is the Pink City, with Hawa Mahal; Udaipur is the City of Lakes, with romantic palaces.
Bali is in Indonesia, with rice terraces and temples; Phuket is in Thailand, with island hopping and nightlife.
Singapore is spotless, with Marina Bay Sands; Hong Kong has a crowded skyline, Disneyland and dim sum.
The Maldives means overwater villas on tiny atolls; Mauritius is one bigger island with mountains and a French-Creole feel.
Darjeeling is in Bengal, with tea gardens and the toy train; Gangtok is the capital of Sikkim, with MG Marg and monasteries.
Both have canals. Venice is Italian, with gondolas; Amsterdam is Dutch, with bicycles and tulips.
Mumbai has the sea, local trains and Bollywood; Delhi is the capital, with the metro and winters.
Bangalore means pubs, traffic and good weather; Hyderabad means biryani and the Charminar.
Kolkata has the Howrah Bridge, yellow taxis and mishti; Chennai has Marina Beach, filter coffee and the heat.
Jaisalmer is a golden fort city in the Thar desert; the Rann of Kutch is a flat white salt desert in Gujarat.
Paris has the Eiffel Tower and croissants; London has Big Ben, red buses and rain.
New York has Times Square and skyscrapers; Las Vegas has casinos in the desert.
Japan has sushi, Mount Fuji and bullet trains; South Korea has K-pop, K-dramas and kimchi.
Kerala is green, with backwaters and houseboats; Rajasthan is desert, with forts and camels.
Ladakh is a cold desert, with Pangong and bike trips; Sikkim is green, with monasteries and Kanchenjunga.
Rishikesh is on the river, with rafting and cafés; Mussoorie is a hill station with Mall Road and views.
Brazil has the Rio carnival, samba and yellow jerseys; Argentina has Messi, tango and blue-and-white stripes.
Egypt has the pyramids and desert; Greece has white-and-blue islands and ruins.
Australia is hot, with kangaroos and cricket; Canada is cold, with maple leaves and snow.
Switzerland has the Alps, chocolate and the DDLJ fields; New Zealand is the Lord of the Rings country.
Bhutan is a Himalayan kingdom with monasteries and no traffic lights; Vietnam has Ha Long Bay, street food and motorbikes.
Sri Lanka is an island with beaches; Nepal is landlocked, with the Himalayas.
The USA has burgers, dollars and fifty states; the UK has tea, the royal family and pounds.
Thailand is hot, beaches and cheap holidays; Russia is huge, freezing and has onion-domed buildings.
Both are volcanic islands. Hawaii is tropical, with surfing; Iceland is icy, with the northern lights.
